title: S01 · Put-away (home kitchen, helper robot)
task: Task: put the apple into the fruit bowl on the island. The apple is on the counter when the agent starts thinking.
change: While it thinks, the helper robot puts the apple into one of three identical lidded bins. Afterwards every bin looks the same.

events.helper_start: the helper robot comes to tidy the counter
events.helper_put_away: the helper put the apple into a bin and closed the lid
